Play.dc.html.title: 4 · Carta cantada: elige si está en tu tabla

title.text: Feria de noche — a lotería night-fair look

how.text: Rules (docs/rules.md): the cantor is automatic. Everyone sees the same drawn card. If it's on your tabla you get three picture choices; every correct pick crosses it out, and the first correct pick earns 2 points. Points only break ties. Wrong taps get a gentle ¡Casi! and another try.

honesty.text: Náhuatl, Maya yucateco and Quechua words are drafts from the deck and always carry the 'palabra en revisión' tag until a native speaker approves them.
